descriptions.notStarted: I hear that Kyrin is looking for me, now that I've become a Captain. She apparently wants to teach me some new skills...
descriptions.inProgress: I must show Kyrin my skills to prove what I'm capable of. I'd better make sure I'm ready to show her everything I've got and stand up to her for at least 2 minutes.
descriptions.completed: I've finally gained Kyrin's confidence. Kyrin taught me the Battleship Skill in return.
